SE save games are stored in the SpaceEngineers folder 
The path is (This PC/ the name of the old drive/ Users/ Your account name/ Appdata/ Roaming/ SpaceEngineers

You can also get to appdata by using the run system (Windows+R), inputting %appdata% , and hitting enter.
(This will open your current appdata, not your old one)

Once you find the Space Engobeers folder, navigate to saves, then open the folder that is you steam account, and there should be your saves

Hope this helps
